summary: Broad i18n testing (frontend-only) for ES/IT across Community, Library and Profile with language=it. PASS: Community chrome (header 'Comunità', subtitle, all topic chips Parrocchia/Messa quotidiana/Rosario/Scrittura/etc.) localized to Italian after ~5–8s. Per-post Translate button works end-to-end: post body stays in original English by default, tapping 'Traduci' replaces body with Italian translation and label becomes 'Mostra originale'; tapping again restores the exact original — author name 'William Phillips' and timestamp '3h · Scripture' are NOT translated (correct). Library book-detail screen fully localized (Confessions → Confessioni, Sant'Agostino d'Ippona, Inizia a Leggere, Capitoli, Libro I/II/III/IV/V…). Profile screen chrome localized (Profilo, Nutrimento, Regime alimentare, Disciplina, Livello di forma, Obiettivo, I miei eventi, Diario, Aiuto e supporto, Informativa sulla privacy, Sanctus Premium · Gestisci, etc.). Bottom tab labels localized (Oggi/Pasti/Allen…/Benes…/Santu…/Parro…/Profilo). EN regression after toggling back works. FAIL (localization gaps): (a) Profile dietary chips (balanced/vegetarian/pescetarian/low-carb/mediterranean) remain English — they use raw RN <Text>. (b) Two Profile admin links remain English: 'Challenges · Review' and 'Library · Radio' — they use raw RN <Text> while the other five admin entries correctly use AutoText. (c) Library 'Films' tab category chips (All/Saints/Doctrine/For Kids/Documentary) and film card titles/blurbs are still English after 8s wait. (d) Library 'Radio' tab: all English station names + blurbs (EWTN Catholic Radio, Guadalupe Radio Network, Iowa Catholic Radio, Real Presence Radio, Relevant Radio, Vatican News — English, iRosary Radio) remain English. (e) Library 'Books' tab: section header 'In-App Reader' + book titles initially loaded all-English on the listing page even after ~9s; the same titles DO translate on the detail page. Likely cause: large batched /api/translate queues finish slowly; chrome strings get cached/translated quickly but the big content batch (~50+ strings) needed >10–15s. Recommend pre-warming /api/translate cache on startup for library catalog + film categories, or adding a server-side pre-translation pass. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none. Console warnings only: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (cosmetic) and expo-notifications listener no-op on web.

critical_code_review_comments: auto-text.tsx flushes every 150ms with a SINGLE setTimeout, so back-to-back AutoText mounts across screens can stack into one big POST /api/translate; a large content payload (50+ strings) appears to take 8–15s to come back, which is why book/station/film cards still show English on the first visit. Consider per-language warmup at app boot for the static Library catalog.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter58 covered ES/IT broad localization. Confirmed: Community header/subtitle/topic-chips translate, per-post Translate button toggles correctly via translateTexts([body],lang), Library book-detail page (Confessioni etc.) translates including chapter list. Remaining gaps (still English under it after wait): (1) Profile dietary chips, (2) Profile admin 'Challenges · Review' and 'Library · Radio', (3) Library films category chips + film card titles/blurbs, (4) Library radio station names + blurbs (English stations only — Italian/Spanish stations are already native-IT/ES by data), (5) Library books listing (book titles still English on first visit although detail page translates fine). When retesting, allow 12–15s after each screen load for the AutoText queue to flush, and prefer reloading once after the first cold run to let the translate cache warm up.
rca_of_issue: Two distinct root causes. (A) Code: a few <Text> nodes were missed during the AutoText migration — profile dietary chips, two admin link entries — so they bypass the AutoText flow entirely. Fix: replace those <Text> with <AutoText> (or use the i18n dictionary). (B) Performance: the AutoText cache is filled lazily via a 150ms-debounced POST /api/translate. When a screen mounts many strings at once (library catalog ~40-60 strings) the round trip is slow enough that the first paint and even the 8s wait shows English. Fix options: (1) Preload /api/translate for the static Library catalog at app boot, (2) Localize the catalog server-side and return per-language fields directly from /api/library/books|stations|films, or (3) Persist the AutoText cache to AsyncStorage so subsequent app launches are instant.
